# Welcome to AFTERLIGHT!
[color=#FDDA0D]AFTERLIGHT is a roleplay-focused Space Station 14 server[/color] where players are intended to maintain continuity round-to-round. If you are new, please feel free to ask for help in OOC (out-of-character chat) or LOOC (local OOC). Remember that you should not discuss IC events in OOC during the round, even if it is information that you believe everybody knows.
If you are new to space station 14 you should take a look at the\n [textlink="New Player's Guide" link="NewPlayer"]
Our rounds are typically 2-5 hours in length. [color=#FDDA0D]You are not expected to stay for the entire round.[/color] If you need to leave early, please try to enter a Cryosleep chamber before disconnecting. These can be found by following station signs. This will remove you from the round and open your role up for someone else to play. If you come back, you will be able to respawn as another character. If you are playing command and are not able to make it to a Cryosleep chamber for whatever reason, please notify a game admin via ahelp.
Lastly, if you need something from admins [color=#FDDA0D]please don't hesitate to ahelp[/color]! The use of ahelp is not limited to rule-related queries or reports. The admins are happy to modify your character, give permission to act antagonistically, and do countless other things. The worst they can say is no!
